_doc: Aluminium alloy EN AW-6060 as Bosch Rexroth supplies its strut profiles, for analysis. Strength, modulus and Poisson's ratio are Rexroth's own technical data, stronger than the least EN 755-2 asks of 6060 in any temper (al6060-t66). The catalogue gives no temper, density or fatigue figure: density is the alloy's, from Hydro's data sheet.
name: al6060-rexroth

modulus.source: Bosch Rexroth, Basic Mechanic Elements MGE 14.0 (3 842 540 392, 2019-07), page 18-12, as republished by RS Components (document A700000009494056)

poisson.source: Bosch Rexroth, Basic Mechanic Elements MGE 14.0 (3 842 540 392, 2019-07), page 18-13, as republished by RS Components (document A700000009494056)

strength.rule: 0.2% proof stress Rp0.2 (in direction of pressure), 195 N/mm²
strength.source: Bosch Rexroth, Basic Mechanic Elements MGE 14.0 (3 842 540 392, 2019-07), page 18-12, as republished by RS Components (document A700000009494056)

ultimate.rule: Minimum tensile strength Rm (in direction of pressure), 245 N/mm²
ultimate.source: Bosch Rexroth, Basic Mechanic Elements MGE 14.0 (3 842 540 392, 2019-07), page 18-12, as republished by RS Components (document A700000009494056)

density.rule: Density of EN AW-6060 (typical at 20 °C): Rexroth's catalogue gives none
density.source: Hydro, Technical datasheet, Extruded products, Alloy EN AW-6060, Rev.4 03/2023, https://hydro.com/globalassets/08-about-hydro/hydro-worldwide/austria/nenzing/alloy-data-sheets/hydro-en-aw-6060.pdf
